ops.title: Store tier is native: engine ownership, the mining→judge fence relaxation, fixture version stamps
ops.body:
The store wave (S0-S3) made the Rust FeedbackEngine (`rust/crates/core/src/feedback.rs`) the sole owner of feedback.db: one connection per file per process, StoreSchema-composition config (extra_ddl per open, guard-ALTERed event columns, run-once migrations, verdict naming, event_filter), sqlite-vec loaded into the engine connection via load_extension. The Python `mining.FeedbackStore` facade is final — downstream HOLDS a store and adds domain methods; FileStateStore and VerdictStoreMixin are deleted; record_verdict is sync (the async signature was a v13 leftover).

**Fence ruling:** the `("mining","judge")` forbidden edge in tests/test_fence.py was deliberately dropped. The approved composition design puts record_verdict/unjudged on the facade ("the facade decides evidence record/clear"), which requires lazy `judge` imports from mining/store.py — the layering inversion is the design, decided with "Native engine + composition". The eager-heavy-import fence still binds (all judge imports in mining/store.py are lazy).

**Engine contract notes:** CPython-sqlite3-faithful exceptions probed and pinned (DataError 'string or blob too big' on >i32::MAX values, ProgrammingError on bind-arity mismatch / unsupported param types / closed-database use / cross-thread use with the check_same_thread message shape, OverflowError on >64-bit ints); config identifiers strictly validated at open; unjudged(limit=0) passes through verbatim to preserve the pinned platform/hook=1-row vs steer=0-row production quirk.

**Fixture stamps:** tests/testdata/store_fixture_*.db are re-recorded by scripts/gen_store_fixtures.py under the engine (rusqlite bundled SQLite, 3.46.0 stamp at header offset 96). A regeneration under a different bundled version changes exactly those 2 bytes per DB — content parity is the invariant, and the committed bytes must always be reproducible by the committed regenerator.
